lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highly regular 2D grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately 10 visible vertical columns and 4-6 horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Blobs are centered at the intersection of faint vertical bands and horizontal zones of elevated pixel intensity, creating a distinct checkerboard pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient transition from higher luminance above to lower luminance shadow below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low density of small, roughly circular high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the leading edge and basal region of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; a high-contrast linear artifact (potential rope or line) is present in the water column directly superior to the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin (lower right) displays a significantly higher spatial density of smaller-diameter high-luminance spots compared to the larger, grid-organized blobs on the lateral flank.
